message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
PROJECT=SUPRA
MISSION=FORCE_ETHERNET_ONLY_AND_RECOVER_DESKTOP_COMMANDER
MODE=EXECUTE_EXISTING_PATH_ONLY
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
NO_WIFI_RECONFIG=YES

PROVEN_NOW:
- SUPRA Drive bridge heartbeat remains CONNECTED.
- Desktop Commander dropped OFFLINE immediately after en0 Wi-Fi power was turned ON.
- Before that, default route was en8 USB 10/100/1G/2.5G LAN, 192.168.1.220, gateway 192.168.1.1, stable.
- Service order has en8 first and Wi-Fi third.

DO NOW:
1) Disable Wi-Fi power on en0 ONLY: networksetup -setairportpower en0 off.
2) Verify default route remains en8 and internet route is alive.
3) Preserve Google Drive, SUPRA bridge 18765, OpenCode 4096, updater, SUPRA, Ethernet and user data.
4) Restart the EXISTING Desktop Commander remote client only if needed, preserving existing device identity; do not revoke/re-pair/reinstall.
5) Return proof of en0 OFF, en8 default, bridge alive, Desktop Commander remote client process alive.

RETURN EXACTLY:
STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|FAIL_BOUNDED
WIFI_EN0=OFF|ON|UNKNOWN
DEFAULT_INTERFACE=en8|OTHER|UNKNOWN
BRIDGE_18765=PASS|FAIL|UNPROVEN
DESKTOP_COMMANDER_REMOTE=PASS|FAIL|UNPROVEN
ACTION_NICOLAS=NONE|<single indispensable action>
